youtube.aciklama: In auditory processing disorder (APD), the pure-tone audiogram is often normal; the difficulty lies in how sound is processed in the central auditory pathways. The most common complaint is trouble understanding speech in noise, but a normal audiogram alone does not establish this diagnosis.
